items.title: Every torsor under the universal Jacobian over M_g is a relative Picard component
items.author: Qixiao Ma
items.difficulty_reason: The universal moduli-stack torsor classification combines the strong Franchetta period calculation with Leray/Kummer reduction, mapping-class-group homology stability and an explicit genus-three Brauer/transgression/Bockstein calculation needed to control the missing low-genus case. Complete original g>=3 and complex-base hypotheses retained. The statement classifies all universal-Mg Jacobian torsors, beyond the old transgression-identification support lemma. It is distinct from AG130 universal plane-curve restricted-base computations and uses different moduli/topological machinery.

primary.label: Complete original universal-Mg Jacobian torsor classification Main Theorem
